subject: Linear A
purpose: Turn the KU-RO/KI-RO behavioral-anchor idea into a frozen, reproducible machine-search procedure whose outputs can create new Linear A semantic or grammatical candidates without researcher-supplied meanings.
non_negotiable_blinding: Linear B phonetic values hidden for primary run
language-family labels hidden during candidate generation

execution_units.name: BEHAVIORAL_OPERATOR_REDISCOVERY
execution_units.goal: Recover the accounting-total relation from numeric structure without exposing the word total.
execution_units.required_behavior: candidate token predicts a quantity equal to the aggregate of associated preceding entries better than matched null

execution_units.name: CONTRAST_DISCOVERY
execution_units.goal: Find tokens whose numeric/document behavior is systematically opposite or complementary to the KU-RO anchor.

execution_units.name: MORPHOLOGICAL_NEIGHBOR_SEARCH
execution_units.goal: Identify recurring prefixes/suffixes or positional variants around the blind candidates.

execution_units.name: HELD_OUT_PREDICTION
execution_units.goal: Test whether a candidate predicts unseen inscriptions, regions, or document types.
execution_units.promotion_requirement: positive effect remains after holdout and null correction

execution_units.name: SEMANTIC_REVEAL_ONLY_AFTER_SCORING
execution_units.rule: Only after blind scoring may known scholarly glosses be revealed for comparison.
execution_units.interpretation: agreement with a scholarly interpretation increases interest but does not itself establish decipherment

critical_prediction: A genuinely useful anchor discovered by the machine should remain detectable when the exact English meaning is hidden, should retain predictive power in held-out Linear A, and should weaken under relation-destroying nulls that preserve superficial statistics.

meta_registry_linkage.CONN_2026_08_13_023: shared relational vocabulary must be blinded

external_corpus_requirements: use a stable digitized Linear A corpus release
record exact corpus version and source identifiers
separate archaeological region/document type before candidate generation
retain original sign IDs and normalized structural encoding as separate layers
never replace sign IDs with semantic English labels in the machine input
important_limits: A candidate that matches a known scholarly translation is not automatically a decipherment.
Linear B overlap may be used only in a separately reported ablation/prior condition.
A coherent AI gloss without held-out predictive support is an OPEN hypothesis.
Failure to discover a candidate does not imply the candidate meaning is false; it means the frozen method did not establish it.
next_execution: Run EA-01 through EA-06 on the digitized corpus; save raw candidate rankings, null distributions, and blind/held-out receipts before semantic reveal.
